messages:
jess (marketing): Heads up — NimbusCloud partner launch. Goal: marketplace listing + joint benchmark blog + one live webinar. Need owners for copy, perf, and routing.

brad (partnerships): Nimbus can co-host webinar and wants a marketplace spotlight the week after. They can provide a customer quote + 1 slide showing cost savings. I'll own partner approvals.

olivia (growth): Proposed webinar Fri May 21 11am ET. Format: 35m technical demo + 20m Q&A. Need an RSVP form that tags demo requests. Also want to test a gated benchmark download to capture MQLs.

elaine (content): I'll draft the blog (bench + joint narrative) and webinar landing page. For the benchmark we should run a realistic e-comm prompt mix (chat + product summary + retrieval). Ask eng for p50/p95, tokens/sec, and cost per 1M tokens across fp16, int8, and 4-bit.

ravi (eng-ml): Can run a 5k mixed workload (50/30/20 char of chat/code/retrieval). Will deliver p50/p95, mean throughput, and a short appendix with test harness config. Will sanitize logs. ETA: Tue May 11 COB.

chris (solutions): For the live demo Redwood will show Dedicated routing + cost dashboard + live inference. Nimbus will show managed endpoint scaling. Need a test tenant and sample dataset. I can set up the tenant if ops approves.

jess (marketing): Reg form fields (keep concise): name, email, company, role, use_case, demo_request (yes/no), utm_source, utm_campaign. If demo_request=yes then route to SDR.

integration-bot: Marketplace assets checklist uploaded: https://assets.nimbuscloud.com/nimbus-redwood.zip.

olivia (growth): UTMs: utm_source=nimbus_partner, utm_medium=partner_webinar, utm_campaign=nimbus_launch_2026. Hidden field for partner_id.

elaine (content): Draft blog headlines: "Benchmarking Predictable Inference: Redwood + Nimbus" or "How Nimbus + Redwood Lower Inference Cost Without Sacrificing Latency". Will include 3 visuals: perf chart, cost table, and architecture callout.

brad (partnerships): Nimbus legal needs review of co-marketing agreement. I'll send their template — expect 4 business days for signatures. We'll hold assets until signed.

ravi (eng-ml): Note on reproducibility: include model commit hash, seed, batch sizes, seq length distribution. I'll provide a small notebook for reviewers.

chris (solutions): Demo owners: Nimbus shows infra + scaling (Brad will coordinate), Chris shows Redwood infra + live console. Rehearsal requested Tue May 18 10am PT — block 45m.

jess (marketing): Marketplace copy needs: 400 char summary, 3 bullets, hero image 1200x400, and 2 screenshots. Also need SSO/SSO integration note and support contact. Who drafts?

brad (partnerships): I'll draft the marketplace blurb and confirm image specs. Nimbus can provide a one-line partner blurb and logo variants.

elaine (content): For gated benchmark PDF — recommend require role + company to download. Lowers volume but better quality. We'll add a short CTA to book a joint demo.

olivia (growth): Routing: all registrants with demo_request=yes -> Redwood SDR queue (tag nimbus_demo). Partner-qualified leads -> forward to Nimbus partner-sales queue. We'll set up a webhook to push to CRM and to Nimbus via secure endpoint.

ravi (eng-ml): Perf deliverables: sanitized CSV, p50/p95, tokens/sec, cost/1M-tokens, config snippet. Will upload to shared drive and mark as "not for public raw logs".

elaine (content): Quote requests: need a 1-2 sentence Nimbus quote and a 1-2 sentence tech blurb from Ravi. Please send by Mon May 10.

integration-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/3111111111 (organizer: marketing).

jess (marketing): Promo schedule: Week -3 teaser, Week -2 blog (gated), Week -1 webinar reminders, Week +1 marketplace spotlight + recording. Social: 2 LinkedIn posts + 1 Twitter thread + partner cross-post.

olivia (growth): Measurement: create GA tag, add campaign UTM, and set CRM mapping for contact.source. Also create a short form question "budgeted for infra?" to help qualify.

brad (partnerships): I uploaded partner assets to the shared folder and pinged Nimbus PM for the customer quote.

chris (solutions): Need test API key ticket — creating request now.

integration-bot: Ticket created #PM-4773 for API key and test tenant provisioning.

jess (marketing): Owners recap: webinar ops (olivia), partner legal & assets (brad), eng perf (ravi), content & blog (elaine), demo (chris), promos & landing (jess). I'll create the canonical checklist doc and link it here.

elaine (content): I'll open a PR for the blog and landing copy Wed morning.

ravi (eng-ml): Will upload perf notebook by May 11 and ping for review.

jess (marketing): Thanks team — let's hit this milestone. If blockers, flag here. :sparkles:
